scope: Production BlockRelay/BlockJournal/PosePacket with simulated Photon, Unity and shared-memory transport; not a two-Steam-account playtest

results.test: packet roundtrip preserves coordinates, state, scene and Lamport stamp
malformed, legacy and oversized block packets are rejected
duplicate and stale edits cannot resurrect an old block
simultaneous conflicting edits converge in opposite delivery orders
receiving a remote revision advances the next local revision
journal bounds new coordinates but allows edits and tombstones at capacity
pose packets reject NaN, Infinity, wrong numeric types and unknown flags
real relay sends live edits between two simulated endpoints
late join receives blocks created while host was alone and removed air states
three endpoints converge after conflicting writes delivered in reverse order
large snapshots are chunked, deduplicated and drain through bounded input batches
viewer-only peer replays remote block states when Minecraft links later
scene isolation rejects delayed airport edits on the island
snapshot remains available after the original host leaves
a claimed live edit from a different actor is rejected
a malformed snapshot chunk is rejected atomically and oversized chunks are refused
an old snapshot arriving after a newer live edit cannot undo that edit
the production relay emits at most sixteen remote MMF inputs per frame
a new Photon session clears the prior session journal and viewer
